# macOS (Apple Silicon) build for ISSE 0.2.0
#
# The original project was generated by the Introjucer for Xcode with an
# Intel-only toolchain (Intel MKL / libiomp5, SSE flags). This file builds the
# same sources natively for arm64 with Apple clang, a vendored JUCE 3.0.0
# (sdks/juce submodule) and Eigen 3.2 headers (fetched into sdks/eigen).
#
# Usage:
#   cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
#   cmake --build build -j

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ISSE VERSION 0.2.0 LANGUAGES C CXX OBJC OBJCXX)

if(NOT APPLE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "This CMakeLists.txt targets macOS. Use builds/Linux/Makefile on Linux.")
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
  set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES arm64 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET)
  set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 11.0 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJCXX_STANDARD 11)

option(ISSE_USE_OPENMP "Link OpenMP (Homebrew libomp) for parallel loops" OFF)

set(JUCE_MODULES_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdks/juce/modules)
set(EIGEN_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdks/eigen CACHE PATH "Eigen 3.2 headers")

if(NOT EXISTS ${JUCE_MODULES_DIR}/juce_core/juce_core.mm)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "JUCE submodule missing. Run: git submodule update --init sdks/juce")
endif()
# Apply local fixes to the pinned JUCE 3.0.0 (idempotent: skipped if already applied).
find_package(Git REQUIRED)
file(GLOB JUCE_PATCHES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/patches/juce/*.patch)
list(SORT JUCE_PATCHES)
foreach(p ${JUCE_PATCHES})
  execute_process(COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} apply --reverse --check ${p}
                  WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdks/juce
                  RESULT_VARIABLE already_applied OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET)
  if(NOT already_applied EQUAL 0)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} apply ${p}
                    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/sdks/juce
                    RESULT_VARIABLE apply_result)
    if(NOT apply_result EQUAL 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Failed to apply JUCE patch ${p}")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "Applied JUCE patch: ${p}")
  endif()
endforeach()

if(NOT EXISTS ${EIGEN_DIR}/Eigen/Core)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Eigen headers not found in ${EIGEN_DIR}. See .github/workflows/macos-arm64.yml for how to fetch Eigen 3.2.")
endif()

# FFTW (single precision). Prefer the static library so the .app is self-contained.
find_path(FFTW_INCLUDE_DIR fftw3.h HINTS /opt/homebrew/include /usr/local/include)
find_library(FFTWF_STATIC NAMES libfftw3f.a HINTS /opt/homebrew/lib /usr/local/lib)
find_library(FFTWF_SHARED NAMES fftw3f HINTS /opt/homebrew/lib /usr/local/lib)
if(FFTWF_STATIC)
  set(FFTWF_LIB ${FFTWF_STATIC})
elseif(FFTWF_SHARED)
  set(FFTWF_LIB ${FFTWF_SHARED})
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "FFTW (fftw3f) not found. brew install fftw")
endif()
message(STATUS "FFTW: ${FFTWF_LIB}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sources (same list the Linux Makefile compiles; JUCE modules use their .mm
# wrappers on macOS so the Objective-C++ native code is compiled).
set(JUCE_MODULES
  juce_audio_basics juce_audio_devices juce_audio_formats juce_audio_processors
  juce_audio_utils juce_core juce_data_structures juce_events juce_graphics
  juce_gui_basics juce_gui_extra)

set(JUCE_SOURCES)
foreach(m ${JUCE_MODULES})
  list(APPEND JUCE_SOURCES ${JUCE_MODULES_DIR}/${m}/${m}.mm)
endforeach()
# See cmake/juce_mac_prefix.h (Carbon "Point" clash with modern SDKs).
set_source_files_properties(${JUCE_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
  COMPILE_OPTIONS "-include;${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/juce_mac_prefix.h")

set(ISSE_SOURCES
  JuceLibraryCode/BinaryData.cpp
  src/api/ISSEngine.cpp
  src/api/ISSFft.cpp
  src/api/ISSStft.cpp
  src/plugin/FilterGraph.cpp
  src/plugin/GraphEditorPanel.cpp
  src/plugin/MainHostWindow.cpp
  src/plugin/PluginListWindow.cpp
)
# Top-level app sources, taken from the Linux Makefile object list.
file(STRINGS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/app_sources.txt APP_SOURCES)
list(APPEND ISSE_SOURCES ${APP_SOURCES})

set(ISSE_ICON ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/FileIcon.icns)
set_source_files_properties(${ISSE_ICON} PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources)

add_executable(ISSE MACOSX_BUNDLE ${ISSE_SOURCES} ${JUCE_SOURCES} ${ISSE_ICON})

set_target_properties(ISSE PROPERTIES
  OUTPUT_NAME ISSE
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/Info.plist.in
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER edu.stanford.ccrma.isse
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME ISSE
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING ${PROJECT_VERSION}
  MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE FileIcon.icns
)

target_include_directories(ISSE PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/JuceLibraryCode
  ${JUCE_MODULES_DIR}
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/api
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/plugin
  ${EIGEN_DIR}
  ${FFTW_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

target_compile_definitions(ISSE PRIVATE
  __SEPARATION_FLOAT_PRECISION__=1
  __MACOSX_CORE__=1
  JUCE_PLUGINHOST_AU=0
  JUCE_PLUGINHOST_VST=0
  JUCE_PLUGINHOST_VST3=0
  JUCE_QUICKTIME=0
  JUCE_USE_CDREADER=0
  JUCE_USE_CDBURNER=0
  $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:DEBUG=1 _DEBUG=1>
  $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:NDEBUG=1>
)

# 2013-era code: keep the build going through modern clang strictness.
target_compile_options(ISSE PRIVATE
  -Wno-deprecated-declarations
  -Wno-deprecated
  -Wno-unknown-pragmas
  -Wno-c++11-narrowing
  -Wno-register
  -Wno-unused-command-line-argument
  -Wno-error=incompatible-function-pointer-types
  -Wno-error=int-conversion
  -fno-objc-arc
)

target_link_libraries(ISSE PRIVATE
  ${FFTWF_LIB}
  "-framework Cocoa"
  "-framework Carbon"
  "-framework CoreAudio"
  "-framework CoreMIDI"
  "-framework AudioToolbox"
  "-framework IOKit"
  "-framework QuartzCore"
  "-framework Accelerate"
  "-framework CoreServices"
  "-framework AppKit"
  "-framework WebKit"
  "-headerpad_max_install_names"
)

if(ISSE_USE_OPENMP)
  find_path(OMP_INCLUDE_DIR omp.h HINTS /opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include)
  find_library(OMP_STATIC NAMES libomp.a HINTS /opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib)
  find_library(OMP_SHARED NAMES omp HINTS /opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib)
  if(OMP_INCLUDE_DIR AND (OMP_STATIC OR OMP_SHARED))
    target_compile_options(ISSE PRIVATE -Xpreprocessor -fopenmp)
    target_include_directories(ISSE PRIVATE ${OMP_INCLUDE_DIR})
    if(OMP_STATIC)
      target_link_libraries(ISSE PRIVATE ${OMP_STATIC})
    else()
      target_link_libraries(ISSE PRIVATE ${OMP_SHARED})
    endif()
    message(STATUS "OpenMP enabled")
  else()
    message(WARNING "libomp not found, building without OpenMP")
  endif()
endif()
